business_summary: City Therapeutics, Inc. operates as a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing RNA interference (RNAi)-based medicines by engineering RNAi trigger molecules. The company develops RNAi-based medicines using engineered small interfering RNAs (siRNAs) and is building a pipeline of therapeutics targeting diseases across multiple therapeutic areas, including ophthalmologic conditions such as retinal diseases and geographic atrophy. It designs and engineers RNAi trigger molecules, such as smaller size, novel cleavage mechanisms, and tailored targeting ligands to enhance potency, specificity, and delivery to various tissue types. Its products includes CITY-FXI, is a city-engineered n-acetylgalactosamine -conjugated small interfering RNA therapeutic targeting factor XI; CITY-RBP4, is a city-engineered GalNAc-conjugated siRNA therapeutic, in development for the treatment of Stargardt disease; CITY-TFR2, is a city-engineered GalNAc-conjugated siRNA therapeutic candidate in development for anemia of chronic disease; The company advances these therapeutics from research through clinical and commercial development stages and engages in strategic collaborations to co-develop RNAi clinical candidates. It has a strategic collaborations with Bausch + Lomb Ireland Limited and Biogen MA Inc. to advance extrahepatic RNAi therapeutics for diseases of the eye and the central nervous system. The company serves clients in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and life sciences industries and collaborates with organizations in the ophthalmology sector. The company was incorporated in 2023 and is based in Cambridge, Massachusetts.
business_summary_ko: City Therapeutics, Inc.는 RNAi 유발 분자를 엔지니어링하여 RNA 간섭(RNAi) 기반 의약품 개발에 중점을 둔 바이오제약 회사로 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 공학적 소형 간섭 RNA(siRNA)를 사용하여 RNAi 기반 의약품을 개발하고 망막 질환 및 지도형 위축과 같은 안과 질환을 포함한 다양한 치료 영역에 걸쳐 질병을 표적으로 하는 치료제 파이프라인을 구축하고 있습니다. 다양한 조직 유형에 대한 효능, 특이성 및 전달을 향상시키기 위해 더 작은 크기, 새로운 절단 메커니즘 및 맞춤형 표적 리간드와 같은 RNAi 트리거 분자를 설계하고 엔지니어링합니다. 해당 제품에는 도시 공학적 n-아세틸갈락토사민 결합 소형 간섭 RNA 치료 표적화 인자 XI인 CITY-FXI가 포함됩니다. CITY-RBP4는 스타가르트병(Stargardt disease) 치료를 위해 개발 중인 도시 공학 GalNAc 결합 siRNA 치료제입니다. CITY-TFR2는 만성 질환 빈혈을 위해 개발 중인 도시 공학 GalNAc 결합 siRNA 치료 후보입니다. 회사는 임상 및 상업 개발 단계를 통해 연구부터 이러한 치료법을 발전시키고 RNAi 임상을 공동 개발하기 위해 전략적 협력에 참여하고 있습니다.
